ground_truth.title: yum package cache is not cleaned after installation
ground_truth.expected_secure_value: yum install -y curl && yum clean all
ground_truth.rationale: Leaving yum metadata and cached packages in an image increases its size and retains unnecessary files. The cache should be removed in the same build layer as the package installation.
